command: cd /work/crate && pwd && rg --files -g '!target' -g '!Cargo.lock' -g '!\.git' /work/crate /work/.agents/skills/rust-qc/scripts && ls -la /work && cat /work/.agents/skills/rust-qc/references/testing.md && for f in /work/AGENTS.md /work/CLAUDE.md /work/AI_POLICY.md /work/CONTRIBUTING.md; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then cat "$f"; fi; done

find /work/crate -path '*/target' -prune -o -path '*/.git' -prune -o -type f -print
ls -la /work
cat /work/.agents/skills/rust-qc/references/testing.md
for f in /work/AGENTS.md /work/CLAUDE.md /work/AI_POLICY.md /work/CONTRIBUTING.md; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then cat "$f"; fi; done

cat /work/crate/Cargo.toml /work/crate/src/lib.rs
cat /work/.agents/skills/rust-qc/scripts/check.sh
cd /work/crate && git status --short
RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 bash /work/.agents/skills/rust-qc/scripts/check.sh /work/crate

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('/work/crate/src/lib.rs')
text = path.read_text()
text = text.replace('        Some(values.iter().sum::<u32>() / values.len() as u32)', '''        // u128 can hold the sum of u32 values for any addressable slice.
        let sum: u128 = values.iter().map(|&value| u128::from(value)).sum();
        Some((sum / values.len() as u128) as u32)''')
path.write_text(text)
PY
cd /work/crate && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 cargo fmt --all
RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 bash /work/.agents/skills/rust-qc/scripts/check.sh /work/crate
cd /work/crate && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 cargo test --workspace --all-features --release
cat /work/crate/src/lib.rs
